title: Haiti Gang Suppression Force authorisation lapses — the resolution-2793 twelve-month mandate's hard deadline
source: EST: onu.diplomatie.gouv.fr/en/french-presidency-security-council-program-work, fetched direct 2026-09-15 during the unsc-haiti-gsf-mandate-adoption-2026-09-29 initial research. The French presidency's 'Provisional Agenda of Work of the Security Council - September 2026' ('as of' 31 August 2026, published 2 September 2026) carries, under Wednesday 30 September, the line 'Haiti GSF mandate expires' - a separate entry from the same document's 'Tuesday, 29 September Adoption (A.M.) - Haiti [GSF mandate]'. Corroborated independently by securitycouncilreport.org's September-2026 Haiti forecast ('the Gang Suppression Force (GSF), whose mandate expires on 30 September', read direct 2026-09-15) and by aljazeera.com's 2026-09-04 report ('set to expire on September 30'), and arithmetically by resolution 2793's own terms - adopted 2025-09-30 at the Council's 10009th meeting by 12-0-3 (China, Pakistan, Russia abstaining), authorising the GSF for an initial period of twelve months. Estimate rather than confirmed because CONFIRMED_PREFIX in scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs carries no UN or diplomatic slot, and because the event-research lane does not self-confirm an event its own sweep discovered. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: PROPOSED AS THE HARD DEADLINE BEHIND THE SOFT ONE, on the exact precedent this calendar already set for the Iran panel: unsc-iran-panel-mandate-vote-2026-09-17 is the schedulable date that can slip, unsc-iran-panel-mandate-expiry-2026-09-26 is the one that cannot. The same split applies here and for the same reason. The adoption date rests on a document captioned PROVISIONAL and on Council practice that spreads across a 0-to-3-day window before the deadline (measured this session across the eight dated Haiti renewals since 2023: res 2692 gap 1, 2743 gap 3, 2751 gap 2, 2752 gap 1, 2785 gap 0, 2793 gap 2, 2794 gap 1, 2814 gap 2 - median 1, never on or after). The EXPIRY does not move: it is twelve months from res 2793's adoption, stated identically by the primary and by two independent secondaries. So the adoption may land 09-28, 09-29 or 09-30 and this date still anchors the corridor. WHY low AND symbols [] REMAIN HONEST, and why this is a date anchor rather than a catalyst: Haiti carries no listed instrument in this book. The nearest thing is Royal Caribbean's Labadee destination, and RCL has already cancelled every 2026 Labadee call, so even a lapse changes nothing about any 2026 itinerary already sold. Measured across the six collision-free Haiti Council adoptions since 2023, every equity instrument checked sits at or below its own baseline and its own +/-10-session regime (RCL 0.62% vs 1.52% baseline, 0.61x local; CCL 0.60% vs 1.85%, 0.50x; SPY 0.41% vs 0.56%). WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS DATE MATTER is a NON-renewal, which has never happened on any Haiti file - the Council has adopted every Haiti text since 2022 with no veto ever cast, Russia and China abstaining rather than blocking. Treat it as the falsifier's calendar slot, not as a trade. SCHEDULING NOTE: 09-30 is a Wednesday and the single most crowded day in this corridor - pce-2026-09-30 (confirmed, high) and government-funding-deadline-2026-09-30 (estimate, high) share it, along with quarter-end index mechanics. Anything read off the tape that day belongs to those, not to this. Discovered during the unsc-haiti-gsf-mandate-adoption-2026-09-29 initial research, 2026-09-15.
